scenes.script_text: The Richest Man in Babylon by George S. Clason in two minutes.
scenes.visual_concept: Colossal centered upright book 'THE RICHEST MAN IN BABYLON' by George S. Clason with zero tilt. Kai and Maya stand in ancient Babylonian gold mastery: Kai pouring gleaming gold coins from an overflowing leather purse, Maya holding an ancient glowing clay tablet of financial laws, broken debt chains at their feet on pure white floor. Viral bubble: 'The Ancient Secret to Never Being Broke!'.

scenes.script_text: Four thousand years ago, Babylon was the wealthiest city on Earth.
scenes.visual_concept: A majestic panoramic view of ancient Babylon: golden sandstone towers, hanging terrace gardens, and merchant ships sailing on the sparkling Euphrates river under bright sun.

scenes.script_text: Its streets were paved with gold, yet most citizens lived in desperate poverty.
scenes.visual_concept: A stark contrast: wealthy royal chariots rolling across polished stones, while poor stickmen citizens sit by the roadside holding empty, deflated cloth coin pouches with sad comic eyes.

scenes.script_text: Why? Because they spent every single coin they earned.
scenes.visual_concept: A stickman laborer receiving a pouch of shiny gold coins, and immediately handing every single coin away to flashy market merchants selling wine, fine silks, and sweet pastries until his hands are completely empty.

scenes.script_text: Here is the timeless secret of Arkad, the richest man in Babylon.
scenes.visual_concept: Arkad (a wise, smiling 2D stickman in an elegant Babylonian tunic with a golden trim) standing calmly with arms outstretched, radiating a warm golden aura while holding a giant glowing clay tablet.

scenes.script_text: First, start thy purse to fattening.
scenes.visual_concept: A flat, deflated leather coin purse expanding like a cartoon balloon into a giant, plump, heavy golden pouch stuffed full of round coins.

scenes.script_text: Pay yourself first.
scenes.visual_concept: Kai standing triumphantly at the head of a line of creditors, firmly placing the first gleaming golden coin directly into his own private locked chest before paying anyone else.

scenes.script_text: For every ten coins you earn, spend only nine.
scenes.visual_concept: A neat visual infographic: 10 golden coins stacked in a row. 9 coins are moved to a basket labeled 'LIVING COSTS', while the 10th coin glows with a golden halo labeled 'YOUR WEALTH'.

scenes.script_text: If you pay the merchant, the landlord, and the tailor first,
scenes.visual_concept: A crowded queue of greedy vendor stickmen (a grumpy landlord holding a rent lease, a tailor holding robes, a merchant holding fruit) greedily reaching their hands out toward a panicked worker.

scenes.script_text: you are a financial slave working for everyone except yourself.
scenes.visual_concept: A stressed stickman attached to heavy iron ball-and-chain weights labeled 'EXPENSES', running endlessly like a treadmill slave while other merchants count his earnings.

scenes.script_text: That tenth coin is yours to keep, forever.
scenes.visual_concept: Maya placing a massive glowing gold coin into a solid steel bank vault with a heavy padlock, winking directly at the viewer with an untouchable sovereign smile.

scenes.script_text: Second, control thy expenditures.
scenes.visual_concept: Kai holding a giant pair of golden scissors, decisively snipping a tangled rope of unnecessary receipts, luxury bills, and impulse purchases.

scenes.script_text: Do not confuse necessary expenses with your desires.
scenes.visual_concept: A giant two-sided ancient scale: on the left plate, simple bread, clean water, and shelter balance evenly; on the right plate, a mountain of luxury gold trinkets and exotic perfumes tilts wildly out of control.

scenes.script_text: What you call necessities will always grow to equal your income
scenes.visual_concept: A visual comparison: as a stickman's salary sack grows from 1x to 5x, his pile of luxury 'necessities' instantly balloons to the exact same size, leaving him with zero savings.

scenes.script_text: unless you set clear boundaries.
scenes.visual_concept: Maya planting a solid brick wall labeled 'BUDGET BOUNDARY' between a growing pile of savings and a mob of shiny impulse temptations.

scenes.script_text: Budget your expenses so you have gold to pay yourself,
scenes.visual_concept: Kai neatly writing on a crisp Babylonian parchment ledger with a quill, carefully allocating gold coins into labeled ceramic jars: 'SAVINGS 10%', 'FOOD', 'HOME'.

scenes.script_text: without depriving your life.
scenes.visual_concept: Kai and Maya enjoying a delicious, wholesome meal together under a shaded grapevine arbor, smiling happily with comfortable abundance and peace of mind.

scenes.script_text: Third, make thy gold multiply.
scenes.visual_concept: A single golden coin splitting into three, then nine, then twenty-seven sparkling coins that multiply exponentially across the frame with bright comic sparkles.

scenes.script_text: A hoarded coin is dead metal.
scenes.visual_concept: A gloomy, dusty dungeon corner where cold grey coins sit lifeless under spiderwebs, turning rusty and stagnant inside a buried clay pot.

scenes.script_text: Gold is a willing worker.
scenes.visual_concept: Cute 2D cartoon gold coins wearing tiny construction hardhats, marching cheerfully with miniature pickaxes and wheelbarrows to build a golden tower of wealth.

scenes.script_text: Put every coin to work so its golden children and grandchildren
scenes.visual_concept: A cartoon family tree of golden coins: a large gold coin patriarch surrounded by dozens of energetic child and grandchild coins, all holding smaller bags of gold.

scenes.script_text: earn income for you while you sleep.
scenes.visual_concept: Kai sleeping peacefully in a comfortable hammock under crescent moon and stars, while cheerful little coin workers quietly stack golden bullion bars beneath him.

scenes.script_text: Wealth is not the coins in your pocket.
scenes.visual_concept: A stickman pulling his empty pockets inside out with a shrug, showing that physical pocket cash disappears the moment you spend it.

scenes.script_text: It is the steady stream of income flowing continuously into your purse.
scenes.visual_concept: A magnificent glowing aquamarine canal of golden water flowing continuously from an abundant mountain spring directly into Maya's leather purse, never running dry.

scenes.script_text: Fourth, guard thy treasures from loss.
scenes.visual_concept: Maya standing as an alert royal sentinel with a polished gold shield labeled 'PRESERVATION', deflecting dangerous flying arrows of risk away from a treasure chest.

scenes.script_text: The first sound principle of investment is security of your principal.
scenes.visual_concept: A solid, unshakeable stone bedrock foundation supporting a golden vault, completely unmoved by raging stormy waves crashing around it.

scenes.script_text: Never trust get-rich-quick schemes,
scenes.visual_concept: A shady carnival barker stickman with a mustache holding a glowing sign reading '1000% PROFIT IN 3 DAYS!', while Kai crosses his arms and smirks in total refusal.

scenes.script_text: and never ask a bricklayer for advice on buying diamonds.
scenes.visual_concept: A confused bricklayer holding a trowel full of wet mortar, examining a giant glittering diamond with a magnifying glass while Maya facepalms with comic sweat drops.

scenes.script_text: Consult only wise men who have proven experience managing gold.
scenes.visual_concept: Kai and Maya sitting respectfully before a circle of wise, gray-bearded Babylonian financial elders holding certified ledgers and golden compasses.

scenes.script_text: Fifth, make of thy dwelling a profitable investment.
scenes.visual_concept: Kai standing proudly before his own debt-free Babylonian home with clean whitewashed walls, a green courtyard, and a thriving fig tree bearing sweet fruit.

scenes.script_text: Own your own roof so your heart is proud
scenes.visual_concept: Kai placing a golden key into his front door, hand on his chest with a warm, proud smile of sovereign ownership.

scenes.script_text: and your living costs are reduced.
scenes.visual_concept: A rent payment bill dissolving into thin air, leaving extra golden coins falling into Maya's savings jar.

scenes.script_text: Sixth, insure a future income.
scenes.visual_concept: An umbrella made of solid woven gold shielding an elderly stickman couple from torrential storm clouds, keeping them completely warm and dry.

scenes.script_text: Provide in advance for your old age
scenes.visual_concept: A cheerful elderly stick figure with a cane and white beard sitting comfortably in a rocking chair, surrounded by grandchildren and overflowing food baskets.

scenes.script_text: and protect your family against sudden misfortune.
scenes.visual_concept: A protective golden dome glowing around a peaceful stickman family home, repelling lightning strikes and dark misfortune clouds outside.

scenes.script_text: And seventh, increase thy ability to earn.
scenes.visual_concept: Kai sharpening an ornate iron tool at a blacksmith forge, his skill bar leveling up dynamically from 'NOVICE' to 'MASTER BLACKSMITH' with glowing sparks.

scenes.script_text: The more wisdom you acquire, the more gold you will attract.
scenes.visual_concept: Maya reading an ancient scroll of wisdom, her head glowing with brilliant light that magnetically pulls floating golden coins toward her like a magnet.

scenes.script_text: Cultivate your skills, respect yourself,
scenes.visual_concept: Kai standing tall in a polished artisan tunic, shaking hands with wealthy merchant patrons who gladly pay premium gold for his masterwork craftsmanship.

scenes.script_text: and seize opportunities without hesitation.
scenes.visual_concept: A glowing golden door labeled 'OPPORTUNITY' swinging open; Maya leaps through boldly without a second of fear, grabbing a golden victory scroll.

scenes.script_text: Gold flees the man who gambles,
scenes.visual_concept: A reckless stickman throwing dice at a shady tavern table, while tiny golden coins with wings frantically fly away from his pockets into the dark.

scenes.script_text: but clings to the man who follows these timeless laws.
scenes.visual_concept: Kai and Maya standing serene and confident, with dozens of solid gold coins magnetically locking onto their belts and purses like loyal soldiers.

scenes.script_text: So tell me in the comments below.
scenes.visual_concept: Kai and Maya standing side-by-side, both pointing dynamic cartoon arrows straight down toward the comment section with engaging smiles and arched eyebrows.

scenes.script_text: Would you rather look rich today while drowning in secret debt?
scenes.visual_concept: A flashy merchant stickman dressed in gaudy purple silk and heavy gold chains, smiling fake for the crowd while chained underwater under a massive sinking anchor labeled '$250,000 DEBT'.

scenes.script_text: Or live modestly and build unbreakable generational wealth?
scenes.visual_concept: Single cohesive 9:16 vertical image split horizontally with central (VS) badge. TOP PANEL: Flashy merchant in gold robes sweating under debt collectors and empty vaults. BOTTOM PANEL: Serene stickman resting in Babylon's lush hanging gardens surrounded by compounding golden vaults of true generational wealth. Central (VS) circular badge.
